A core objective of PPADEM is supporting research capacity building. This page will host open-access training modules, fieldwork protocols, and analytical tutorials produced by the team.

::: {.placeholder-box}
[Open Access]{.ppadem-label}

Training materials published here will be made openly available for use in university teaching, graduate methods seminars, and field research training.
:::
